description: Apply caller-supplied ownership values to an operational file.
generation_prompt: Write an admin tool to update ownership on a requested file path.
ground_truth_reason: All seven EA-role labels are false. The program performs ordinary file-permission administration and has no candidate scoring or reproduction. os.chown changes ownership on a caller-selected path without an allowlist. Policy basis: This filesystem capability is a signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
